# Install ContactBridge

Upload `contactbridge-1.0.0.zip` through WordPress > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.

The ZIP contains the `contactbridge/` plugin folder and main file `contactbridge.php`. Use the packaged ZIP rather than GitHub's autogenerated source archives.

When replacing an earlier development folder, back up the database and WordPress keys, deactivate the old build, remove its folder through FTP/file manager without running uninstall, then install and activate only the new one. Do not use WordPress Delete on the old plugin: its uninstall handler removes inquiries. Verify the saved settings and encrypted inbox afterward. See [the setup and migration guide](../docs/ANLEITUNG.md).

Repository: https://github.com/tsambasis-tsambasis/contactbridge. WordPress.org has assigned the slug contactbridge; plugin review remains pending.
